g.title: G
g.text: Indradhanu — State and Memory Scoping per Agent

g.title: cluster_sub
g.text: Agent / subgraph state (private: each sees only its own keys)

g.title: cluster_store
g.text: Long-term memory — Store (PostgreSQL + pgvector), one namespace per agent

g.title: ckpt
g.text: • snapshot of state after every node
• pause for human approval, resume later

g.title: main->st_res
g.text: only the keys each agent needs

g.title: ns_orders
g.text: • standing orders written by officers only

g.title: guard
g.text: Memory access policy (enforced on every read / write)
• metadata filter (namespace, agency, ward) before vector similarity
• content screened before it is stored · officers alone write orders

g.title: ledger
g.text: • which agent read or wrote which row
• in which incident thread, and why
